Rush delivery in Columbia, SC

Forgot something? Customer waiting? With Rush, your order goes to the front of the line and is driven straight to the drop-off. No stops for other orders in between.

Get your instant price Call (803) 949-7034

About 2 hours around Columbia

For trips within about 50 miles of the pickup, Rush delivery usually takes about 2 hours. Rush orders are handled before standard ones. Longer trips take as long as the drive, and your quote shows the estimate before you book.

Follow it the whole way

You get a tracking link to watch the driver on the map, and we confirm the delivery with a photo, signature and GPS location so you know exactly when it arrived and who signed for it.

How it works

  1. 1. Get your price

    Enter the pickup and delivery addresses for an instant quote. No calling around.

  2. 2. Book in minutes

    Choose standard or Rush and a car, minivan or pickup truck, then pay securely online.

  3. 3. Track it live

    Follow the driver on the map. Delivery is confirmed with a photo, signature and GPS location.

Questions

How much does Rush cost?

Rush adds a fee to the regular price, starting at $25 for local trips. Your quote shows the exact amount.

Can I book Rush at night or on weekends?

Yes, anytime between 8 AM and 10 PM, seven days a week.
